scenes.title: Max's Promises
scenes.summary: Max and Vika return home early to find Denis still living in their apartment, and Vika confronts Max about his unkept promises regarding the sous-chef job.

scenes.title: Hard Work of a Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno, sous-chef Lyova struggles to manage the busy kitchen while his former boss Viktor Barinov mocks his French pronunciation and walks off to smoke.

scenes.title: Talking with German
scenes.summary: Max nervously enters German Land's office to ask about the vacant sous-chef position, and German surprises him by immediately accepting his candidacy.

scenes.title: Elena Pavlovna's Advice
scenes.summary: Lyova begs Elena Pavlovna to make Viktor Petrovich the sous-chef instead, but Elena insists that Lyova discipline his former boss and oversee tomorrow's royal crab order.

scenes.title: The New Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: German Land gathers the kitchen brigade of Claude Monet and introduces Max Lavrov as their new sous-chef, prompting immediate teasing from Fedya and Senya.

scenes.title: Money for the Apartment
scenes.summary: Denis shows Max sixty thousand rubles that he claims his mother sent for rent, and after Senya easily pickpockets the envelope, Max takes the cash for safekeeping.

scenes.title: The Royal Crab
scenes.summary: German orders Max to downsize the kitchen staff by firing one cook, while over at Arcobaleno Timur delivers a live royal crab to Lyova.

scenes.title: Fine for Smoking
scenes.summary: Fed up with Viktor Barinov's constant smoke breaks and lack of respect, Lyova demands to be addressed by his patronymic and fines his former boss.

scenes.title: A Difficult Firing
scenes.summary: Max tries to carry out German's order to fire a cook, but when the man breaks down crying about his family and bank loan, Max softens and lets him stay.

scenes.title: Vika's Brilliant Idea
scenes.summary: At home, Max admits to Vika that he could not bring himself to fire the cook, and Vika suggests getting the cook hired by rival restaurant Arcobaleno instead.

scenes.title: Nighttime Revenge
scenes.summary: Late at night in the Arcobaleno kitchen, Chef Viktor Barinov sneaks to the fridge where the royal crab is stored and unplugs it to take revenge on Lyova.

scenes.title: Salary Rumors
scenes.summary: To trick one cook into resigning and moving to Arcobaleno, Max whispers a fake rumor that German is cutting everyone's salaries in half, not realizing Senya is overhearing.

scenes.title: The Spoiled Crab
scenes.summary: When VIP guest Nikolai Andreyevich arrives for lunch at Arcobaleno, Lyova opens the unplugged refrigerator to find the royal crab spoiled, and Elena fines him twenty thousand rubles.

scenes.title: Crab Sticks
scenes.summary: Feeling guilty over his prank, Chef Viktor Barinov takes command of the Arcobaleno kitchen and uses crab sticks and ginger sauce to save the royal crab dish.

scenes.title: Mutiny in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Having overheard Max's fake rumor in the washroom, Senya tells the entire Claude Monet brigade that German is cutting salaries, and Max scrambles to stop them from storming German's office.

scenes.title: Workplace Gymnastics
scenes.summary: Inside the office, Max hands German the cook's voluntary resignation letter and claims the crowd outside is asking for permission to do workplace gymnastics in the courtyard.

scenes.title: Culinary Triumph
scenes.summary: Max boasts to his brigade that he forced German to keep their salaries intact, while at Arcobaleno Viktor Barinov's fake royal crab dish is a triumph with the VIP guests.

scenes.title: The Fake Bonus
scenes.summary: Celebrating Max as a fearless leader, Fedya and Senya urge him to demand a bonus from German, and Max panics and hands out Denis's sixty thousand rubles as a fake bonus.

scenes.title: Exposure in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: German catches the cooks smoking in the courtyard, exposing Max's lies about workplace gymnastics and salary cuts, and back at home Vika learns Max spent the sixty thousand rubles.

scenes.title: A Noble Deed
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna demotes Lyova and appoints Viktor Barinov sous-chef, but when Barinov realizes Lyova knew about the lighter in the fridge and protected him, he confesses the truth to Elena.
